name: VICTORIOUS
source:
[B]How will look your first day at School for Gifted?[/b]
Become a new student with special ability in a school for... dogs with super powers. Meet other students and teachers. Explore the facility. Fight for your honor. ...wait? Fight??

[From [url=https://thatsarcastictype.itch.io/victorious]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[B]你在天才学校的第一天会是什么样子？[/b]
成为一所专为拥有超能力的狗狗开设的学校的具有特殊能力的新生。认识其他学生和老师。探索该设施。为你的荣誉而战。…等待？斗争？？
